segments.text: Ah, would removing all of the water from the swimming pools in Australia, all of them, would that be a significant way to reduce the effects of the drought?
No. Roughly 25 million people in Australia, one in three has a house, so that's eight million houses. Roughly one in every ten has a swimming pool, so that's 800,000 swimming pools.
Each swimming pool is about 40 tonnes of water, so that would mean roughly a box, maybe 300 or so metres on a side of water, less than a cubic kilometre.
It is not enough that one third of a cubic kilometre is not enough to significantly affect the droughts that come on here to see us here in Australia.
